parameters.name: AccountPassword
parameters.description:
The password of the initial account.

Password rules:

- The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length.
- The password must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.
- Supported special characters include !@#$%^&*()_+-=.

parameters.name: AutoScale
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable auto start/stop. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is false.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The idempotency token. Ensures that duplicate requests do not result in duplicate operations.

parameters.name: DiskPerformanceLevel
parameters.description:
The performance level (PL) of the cloud disk. If this parameter is not specified, the default value PL0 is used.

Valid values:

- PL0
- PL1
- PL2
- PL3

parameters.name: EngineVersion
parameters.description:
The DPI engine version. If this parameter is not specified, the default value PG15 is used. PG17 and later versions support the data sandbox (branch) feature.

Valid values:

- PG15: PostgreSQL 15.
- PG17: PostgreSQL 17, which supports the data sandbox feature.

parameters.name: PayType
parameters.description:
The billing type. If this parameter is not specified, the default value Free is used.

Valid values:

- Free: Free tier.
- Postpaid: Pay-as-you-go.
- Prepaid: Subscription.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description:
The unit of the subscription duration. This parameter takes effect only when PayType is set to PrePay. If this parameter is not specified, the default value Month is used.

Valid values:

- Month: month.
- Year: year.

parameters.name: ProjectName
parameters.description:
The name of the Supabase project.

Naming rules:

- The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length.
- The name can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).
- The name must start with a letter or an underscore (_).

parameters.name: ProjectSpec
parameters.description: The specifications of the Supabase project. The Free billing type uses free-tier specifications. For paid billing types, the specifications must match those available in the console.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. Specifies the region in which to create the project.

parameters.name: SecurityIPList
parameters.description: The IP address whitelist. Separate multiple IP addresses or CIDR blocks with commas (,). If this parameter is not specified, the default value 0.0.0.0/0 is used.

parameters.name: StorageSize
parameters.description: The storage size, in GB. If this parameter is not specified for non-Free billing types, the default value is 1 GB.

parameters.name: UsedTime
parameters.description: The subscription duration. This parameter takes effect only when PayType is set to PrePay. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is 1.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch ID. This parameter is required. The zone of the vSwitch must be the same as the value of ZoneId.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC). This parameter is required.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone ID. The zone of the vSwitch specified by VSwitchId must be the same as this parameter value.
